text:
maria_cs: Heads up — Averon Health sent final vendor questionnaire (SOC2 + DPA). They want clarifications on KMS, data residency for embeddings, and snapshot retention. I can compile answers but need engineering + security confirmation. Copying @elaine_sec and @sam_eng. Attached form: https://confluence.redwood/attachments/averon_vendor_form.pdf

elaine_sec: Thanks. Quick answers: Hosted (Redwood API) uses managed KMS by default; we support BYOK for Private deployments (customer-managed KMS). SOC2 scope: production-only; non-prod access limited with RBAC + ephemeral keys. I'll add exact SOC2 cert dates in a doc. :ok_hand:

sam_eng: For embeddings storage — we persist vectors in our encrypted object store in the tenant's pinned region when they choose residency. For hosted, default is `us-east-1`. For Dedicated/Private we can pin region and restrict egress. Config snippet: `storage.residency = "us-east-1"`

jordan_legal: I'll review wording for DPA clause on subprocessors. For BYOK we need to confirm HSM/KMS integration details are documented. Elaine, can you paste the KMS setup doc link?

elaine_sec: Link: https://confluence.redwood/sec/kms-byok (internal). TL;DR: BYOK supported only on Private with negotiated keys; rotation policy optional but rotation logs retained 90 days by default. Evidence: key rotation logs + access audits available for SOC2 evidence.

maria_cs: Great — I'm going to draft answers. Can you each approve by EOD tomorrow? Averon expects handback by Friday COB.

sam_eng: :+1: I can check the residency statement and retention windows today, ETA 2pm.

elaine_sec: I'll draft the SOC2 evidence notes and confirm cert dates. ETA 4pm.

jordan_legal: I'll review legal phrasing by 5pm. If any material changes, ping me and I'll prioritize.

kevin_customer: Hi team — thanks for the quick response. One more Q: are embeddings retained for model tuning? We want assurance they're not used to train public or third-party models.

elaine_sec: Short answer: we do NOT use production customer embeddings to train public models. We only use aggregated telemetry (non-content metrics) for quality and performance monitoring. I'll include an explicit statement in the handback and reference the DPA clause.

maria_cs: Perfect — I'll assemble answers and inline the form. Plan: produce a redlined PDF with numbered answers and a separate evidence bundle (SOC2 cert, rotation logs excerpt, residency config). Can you confirm attachments will be ok?

docu-bot: Document uploaded: s3://redwood-results/averon_handback/2026-03-24/averon_answers_bundle.pdf

maria_cs: Uploaded. @kevin_customer, shared link with Averon: https://files.redwood/averon_handback/averon_answers_bundle.pdf — let us know if you'd like a short walkthrough next week. :pray:

kevin_customer: Received, thanks. Can we do a 30 min walkthrough Tues 2026-03-31? Prefer afternoon PST.

maria_cs: Works for us. Tentative invite sent for Tue 3/31 15:00 PST. I'll close the thread after the meeting is scheduled. Thanks everyone!
